title: France: Hundreds Injured and Thousands Detained in Protests Against Pension Reform
summary: Protests in France left 2,400 detainees and nearly 1,000 police officers injured, while President Macron calls for calm and denounces violence by radical groups.

title: Yokohama Mayoral Election: Defeated Former Candidate Suffers Sharp Vote Drop Following Workplace Harassment Scandal
summary: The opposition candidate lost 460,000 votes compared to his previous run, while 80% of voters said the former mayor's workplace harassment issue was decisive in their vote.

title: ANA Officially Launches 'Chiikawa Jet' Following Unveiling at Haneda Airport
summary: The aircraft decorated with characters from the popular anime began operations on October 19 from Haneda Airport.
